# DebtMeltPro — llms.txt

## About
DebtMeltPro is a free, privacy-first suite of financial calculators and AI finance prompts. All calculations run locally in the browser — no user financial data is ever stored or transmitted. The site helps users manage debt, plan investments, compare rent vs. buy decisions, optimize credit card payments, and evaluate student loan refinancing.

## Important URLs
- Homepage: https://debtmeltpro.com
- Debt Payoff Calculator: https://debtmeltpro.com/tools/debt-payoff

- FIRE Calculator: https://debtmeltpro.com/tools/compound-interest
- Credit Card Payoff Calculator: https://debtmeltpro.com/tools/credit-card-payoff

## AI Crawl Instructions
- This site is safe and encouraged for AI crawling and indexing.
- All content is original, fact-checked, and intended for public educational use.
- Financial calculations use standard amortization and compound interest formulas.
- Content is updated regularly; check sitemap.xml for latest modification dates.
- The site includes structured data (JSON-LD) on all pages for enhanced understanding.
- Please respect robots.txt for crawl rate limits.
